full_name: Marwa Elshakry | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2006–2007 History Joy Foundation Fellow Harvard University
bio: Marwa Elshakry is an assistant professor at Harvard University, where she teaches science in cross-cultural contexts, with a special focus on science, religion, and empire in the nineteenth and twentieth centuries.
